# @crup/react-timer-hook

Deterministic React timer lifecycle hooks for timers, schedules, and many independent timers.

Docs: https://crup.github.io/react-timer-hook/
Package: @crup/react-timer-hook
Install alpha: npm install @crup/react-timer-hook@alpha
Repository: https://github.com/crup/react-timer-hook

Public exports:
- useTimer(options): one deterministic timer lifecycle.
- useTimerGroup(options): many keyed independent lifecycles with one shared scheduler.
- durationParts(milliseconds): duration display helper.

Core rules:
- Use timer.now for wall-clock deadlines and clocks.
- Use timer.elapsedMilliseconds for active elapsed duration.
- Use endWhen(snapshot) to end a lifecycle.
- Use cancel(reason) for terminal early stops.
- Schedules run while active and default to overlap: 'skip'.
- Debug logs are opt-in only.
- Formatting, locale, timezone, caching, retries, and business rules are userland.
